defect_observations.observation: The enclosure 5.07517 < ln 160 < 5.07518 is asserted with only the series method named; no partial sums or remainder bound are computed. The ceiling claim needs only 5.075 < ln 160 < 5.08, and ln 160 = 5.07517..., so the value is checkable, but the computation is not displayed.

The forward pointer promises 'the exact thresholds in nt^2 at which the exponential bounds fall below the one-sided and two-sided Chebyshev values'. thm:p15-w02b-p15-063-chebyshev-comparison gives exact thresholds only for A_3 against K_6 (x_*) and 2A_3 against K_5 ([x_-, x_+]). A_1 and A_2 get only the sufficient condition nt^2 > x_* and the small-t reversal in part 3. Read as covering A_1 and A_2, the sentence promises more than is proved; read as A_3 and 2A_3, it is met.

The claim that the ordinary one-n bound does not by itself establish the simultaneous statement is not addressed in annex:p15.conc-time-uniform. It is substantiated by thm:p15-w02b-p15-063-reuse-failure, which is reached only through the chapter's closing pointer (lines 463-466), not from the entry.
Wording defect: 'assume that testing one represented hypothesis on one encoded observation is assumed to take polynomial time' repeats the modal. The meaning is unaffected.
